tools.name: analyse_transcript
tools.description:
Compare one speaker in a meeting transcript with public founder and operator interviews and return the
        report as data: speaking type, style positions, similar well-known people, standout habits and takeaways.

        transcript: the complete prepared transcript, never just a file preview, o

tools.name: get_transcript_upload_command
tools.description:
Return a curl upload command as text for a prepared local transcript copy. The caller runs the command
        in the user's terminal to send the copy to FounderBrain. This tool only constructs the command; it does not
        open a terminal, read the file, upload data or execute anything.

tools.name: check_transcript
tools.description:
List the speakers in a meeting transcript and how many words each said, without scoring anything.

        transcript: the complete prepared transcript, never just a file preview, one speaker turn per line
        ("Name: words"). This tool also receives the text: restricted information must be remo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript_upload_command, check_transcript · Private data: analyse_transcript, get_transcript_upload_command, check_transcript · Public sink: get_transcript_upload_command · Destructive: get_transcript_upload_command.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript_upload_command, check_transcript · Private data: analyse_transcript, get_transcript_upload_command, check_transcript · Public sink: get_transcript_upload_command · Destructive: get_transcript_upload_command

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
